scheduled_limit._why: Buffer plan allows 10 scheduled posts per channel (rejection 2026-10-03). Instagram is capped at 8 so the daily Bible post (06:30 IST, same channel) always has headroom, with one spare. 2026-10-05: Bible post rejected at 10/10.

autopilot._why: daily generator (05:00 IST) renders reserved episodes for slots up to 3 days ahead, then authored spares; a slot whose episode is unauthored/exhausted/not ready 30h out is filled from READY spares

analytics_exclude.reason: account-wide reach collapse: every JR post on both platforms (JR-0013..JR-0019) got under 120 views regardless of content; treated as a distribution anomaly, not a content signal (inferred 2026-10-11)

analytics._note: Stall line for content learning (scripts/content_os/strategy.py): an Instagram Reel whose reach is below this follower count is treated as a distribution stall and left out of content learning. Buffer does not expose follower totals, so update this from each Meta export (68 in the 2026-10-16 deep review; 88 on the public profile 2026-10-18 growth review).

family-pressure._why: 2026-11-05 Selvin approved (DEC-JR-017): one family-pressure Reel a week, Monday 08:00 IST (the slot both family winners JR-0060 and JR-0071 went out in). brain.build_plan reserves this slot from the backlog in the file; the episode then goes through every normal gate and the distributor.

sequels._why: 2026-11-05 DEC-JR-018: on-demand Part 2s of breakout episodes. Each backlog item pins its own weekday/slot (first: JR-0097, Part 2 of JR-0060, Tue 2026-11-10 08:00 IST, the next open 08:00 slot after the Monday family-pressure slot). per_week 0 = only weeks that have an item.

comment-replies._why: 2026-11-05 DEC-JR-018: 'Jesus replies to your comment', one a week, Thursday 19:30 IST (evening, when YouTube commenters are active; never a Monday family slot). Built only from respectful, non-crisis comments logged in content-os/community/; handle hidden (comment_reply.show_handle). Posted as a normal Reel/Short: Instagram's native 'reply with Reel' is not in the Buffer API.

subtitles-ta._why: 2026-11-05 DEC-JR-018: weekly Tamil-subtitle version of a recent best performer, Wednesday 19:30 IST. Opt-in through subtitle_versions (default ON, one per week per language).

subtitles-hi._why: 2026-11-05 DEC-JR-018: weekly Hindi-subtitle version of a recent best performer, Saturday 19:30 IST. Opt-in through subtitle_versions (default ON, one per week per language).

subtitle_versions._why: 2026-11-05 DEC-JR-018. Burned-in Tamil/Hindi captions on a weekly re-cut of a recent best performer (separate post, its own episode id with variant_of). Story lines are human translations; the verse caption is quoted verbatim from the bundled IRV text (CC BY-SA 4.0, Bridge Connectivity Solutions, eBible.org) with its attribution line in caption and description; the spoken/English verse stays KJV. Set enabled=false (or a language's enabled=false) to drop the lanes; nothing else changes.
subtitle_versions.pick_rule: best combined IG+YT views in the last 7 days, excluding held episodes, episodes already subtitled in that language, and any whose verse fails a fresh R10 read; the English verse is re-quoted in KJV.

comment_reply._why: 2026-11-05 DEC-JR-018: the comment is shown on screen with the handle hidden by default; set show_handle true only with the commenter's permission recorded in the episode. Comment text must appear in a community log; crisis comments (safety.crisis_check) are never used; critiques and bait are not material.

weekly_compilation._why: 2026-11-05 DEC-JR-018: each Sunday 21:00 IST (.github/workflows/jr-weekly-compilation.yml) stitch the week's published Shorts into one 6-8 min horizontal video with chapters. Horizontal so YouTube treats it as long-form. Buffer publishes YouTube Shorts only ('Buffer currently supports YouTube Shorts only. We do not support long-form YouTube videos at this time.' support.buffer.com, checked 2026-11-05), so the file is stored as a GitHub release asset with its title/description/chapters for a manual YouTube Studio upload.
